summary.text: Corynne Courpas is the Democratic candidate for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 42C, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

A Carroll County resident who retired in 2020, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she grew up in a small family restaurant business and is focused on school funding, solar energy and small business affordability.

paragraphs.text: Courpas earned a high school diploma from Franklin High School, a bachelor's degree from McDaniel College in 1976 and a graduate degree from the University of Baltimore in 1987, according to Ballotpedia.
Her career experience includes working as a sales consultant.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she grew up in a small business household, the Frisco Family Pub, and has lived and worked in Carroll County for most of her life.
She said she has volunteered in her community since retiring in 2020.
Courpas advanced from the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Steve Patten in the general election for an open seat.

She said she would work to secure funding for school maintenance and new schools, advocate for a comprehensive solar energy plan, and seek tax and regulatory relief and affordable health care plans for small businesses.
She listed endorsements from groups including the Maryland State Education Association, the Sierra Club, the League of Conservation Voters and Maryland NOW.
